charge_id: string -- unique id for this generated charge ticket, format: <encounter_id>-<utc-timestamp>
generated_at_utc: string -- ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the charge ticket was produced
model_used: string -- OpenAI model name used for drafting
normalized_notes: string -- output of Phase 2; multiple source documents reconciled into one coherent narrative

coded_entities.text: string -- the surface form found in the normalized notes
coded_entities.laterality: string or null -- left | right | bilateral | null
coded_entities.units: integer or null -- count of times a procedure was documented as performed
coded_entities.code_system: string or null -- ICD-10-CM | CPT | HCPCS
coded_entities.source: string -- one of: rag | icd10_api | hcpcs_api | none

charge_draft.claim_notes: string -- reconciliation summary and every compliance flag a human reviewer must see before submission

output_file: string -- path where this JSON was persisted
